_comment: Channel map for the dexter server. mode is the default approval posture per DESIGN.md §7: auto acts, plan proposes first, approve requires a yes before any action. Blast radius sets the default, and any message can override it.

general.purpose: Discord's default channel. Scratch space; nothing routes here.

dexter.purpose: Main line to Dexter. Anything without a better home.

skills.purpose: Live skill registry, regenerated from intel/skills by cron. Invoke skills here.

queue.purpose: Deferred work, dependency-ordered. Nothing is dropped, only blocked.

inbox.purpose: Dexter asks, you answer. Buttons and polls land here so a reply is one tap.

log.purpose: Run history, router decisions, cost. Quiet unless you go looking.

thinking.purpose: Dexter's reasoning, rendered as muted embeds so it never reads as an answer. Firehose for long-running tasks; short tasks thread their reasoning off the triggering message instead.

recruiting.purpose: Recruiting. The job-search skills run here.

outreach.purpose: Cold outreach and warm intros. Drafts only; nothing sends without an explicit yes.

sourcing.purpose: SaaS and client sourcing. outbound-sourcing runs here.

experiments.purpose: Run things and see. Low blast radius on purpose, so Dexter acts without asking.

learning.purpose: Reading paths, papers, teaching videos. The papers skill runs here.

people.purpose: People worth knowing, VC contacts, the superconnector map.

prospective-ideas.purpose: Prospective ideas, captured verbatim. Distant connections get surfaced here.

building.purpose: Building Dexter itself — features, architecture, what to build next.

guidelines.purpose: Engineering guidelines. Each is a +lens; full references in kernel/guidelines/.

perspectives.purpose: How Jai sees things — perspectives and further insights, plug-and-play into prompts.

notes.purpose: Jai's own notes: life, meetings, thinking. Dexter READS this for context and NEVER writes here.

_writeComment: write=dexter means Dexter maintains it and Jai reads it; he never files entries there by hand. Ask for a feature anywhere and Dexter writes the queue item itself. write=both means either party starts a conversation.
_categoryComment: Three sections. 'Yours' is your life and work — you write, Dexter replies. 'Builder' is the system building itself. 'Notes' is yours alone: Dexter reads it for context and never posts there.
